vv75:1.1: CHAṬṬHO VII SUNIKKHITTAVAGGA Yathā vanaṃ Cittalataṃ pabhāsati uyyānaseṭṭhaṃ Tidasānam uttamaṃ tathūpamaṃ tuyham idaṃ vimānaṃ obhāsayaṃ tiṭṭhati antalikkhe. || ||
vv75:2.1: Deviddhipatto 'si mahānubhāvo manussabhūto kim akāsi puññaṃ kenāsi evaṃ jalitānubhāvo vaṇṇo ca te sabbadisā pabhāsatī ti. || ||
vv75:3.1: So devaputto attamano Moggallānena pucchito pañhaṃ puṭṭho viyākāsi yassa kammass' idaṃ phalaṃ. || ||
vv75:4.1: Ahaṃ manussesu manussabhūto daliddo atāṇo kapaṇo kammakaro ahosiṃ jiṇṇe ca mātāpitaro abhāriṃ piyā ca me sīlavanto ahesuṃ annañ ca pānañ ca pasannacitto sakkacca dānaṃ vipulaṃ adāsiṃ.
